name: paul-skills
description: Paul’s skill library with source tracking and human-reviewed improvements

scripts.check: npm run check-plugin-version && python3 scripts/check-skills.py && npm test
scripts.check:local: npm run check && npm run test:graders && npm run test:pm-beta && git diff --check
scripts.test:pm-beta: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 evals/product-management-beta/verify.py && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 evals/pm-conversation-beta/verify.py && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s evals/product-management-beta -p test_verify.py -v
